seo_title: Restaurant Marketing Ideas in Delhi: Win More Direct Orders
description: Restaurant marketing ideas for Delhi: balance Zomato and Swiggy with direct orders, rank on Google Maps, make Reels that fill tables and take WhatsApp orders.
headline: Restaurant marketing ideas in Delhi: Zomato, direct orders, Maps, Reels and WhatsApp
card_text: How Delhi restaurants can keep using Zomato and Swiggy for discovery while building direct orders through Google Maps, Reels and WhatsApp.
intro:
Most lists of restaurant marketing ideas for Delhi stop at "post on Instagram and run a Zomato offer". The harder question every owner in Rajouri Garden, Hauz Khas or Dwarka is asking is different: how do I keep getting orders from Zomato and Swiggy without handing a large share of every bill to the apps, and how do I get people to walk in, book a table or order from me directly?

This guide answers that. It covers how to think about aggregator costs, the profile that wins the Google Maps search in your locality, Reels that fill tables rather than just collect likes, a WhatsApp ordering setup that turns one-time app customers into regulars, and a calendar built around Delhi's eating-out seasons. If you want the broader overview for cafés and bakeries too, start with our restaurant, café and bakery marketing guide.

sections.h2: Zomato and Swiggy vs direct orders: do the maths first
sections.html:
Aggregators are the best discovery engine a new restaurant in Delhi has. Customers already have the apps, delivery is handled and the listing works from day one. The cost is the commission. Industry estimates for 2026 put it at roughly 18–30% of order value depending on your contract and exclusivity, plus GST on platform fees, optional in-app ads and any discounts you fund. Rates and terms change and differ by outlet, so read your own partner agreement and payout statements rather than relying on a figure from a blog.

Take an order of ₹600 and write down, from your own payout report, what actually reached your bank account. Compare it with a direct order, where you pay for packaging, delivery and a small payment fee. That gap is what each direct order is worth, and how much you can spend to win one.

ChannelWhat it is good forMain cost
Zomato and SwiggyDiscovery, first orders, late-night and lunch deliveryCommission, ads and discounts
Direct orders (WhatsApp, phone, own link)Repeat customers, large family and office ordersYour delivery, packaging, payment fees
Dine-in and table bookingsHigher bills, groups, celebrationsStaff and space; marketing to fill slow slots
Zero-commission or ONDC-linked appsExtra reach at lower cost where they are liveDelivery fees; smaller customer base so far

The goal is not to leave the apps. It is to use them to meet a customer once, and then give that customer a good reason to order from you directly the second time.

sections.h2: Win the Google Maps search in your locality
sections.html:
When someone in Delhi searches "north Indian restaurant near me", "momos in Lajpat Nagar" or "family restaurant Dwarka", the map pack decides who gets the visit. It is free and it changes every few kilometres, so you are competing with the restaurants around you, not the whole city.

  1. Choose a specific primary category, such as "North Indian restaurant" or "Chinese restaurant", rather than just "Restaurant".
  2. Upload the full menu with prices and keep it current. A menu photo from two years ago with old prices costs you trust.
  3. Add your own ordering and booking links where your profile allows it, so a customer can order from you directly instead of only through an app.
  4. Post real photos every week of dishes, seating and the kitchen.
  5. Keep hours exact, including late nights, Sundays and festival days, and mark special hours before Diwali and New Year.
  6. Reply to every review, especially complaints about delivery or wait times, in a calm, specific way.

Diners read reviews closely before choosing where to eat. Ask at the table when the customer is happy, and put a short review link on the bill and the takeaway bag. Our guides on Google Business Profile optimisation in Delhi and getting more Google reviews go step by step.

sections.h2: Reels that fill tables, not just collect likes
sections.html:
Instagram is where many Delhi diners decide where to go this weekend. A Reel with lakhs of views from people in another city does little for a restaurant in Pitampura. What works is content that makes a local viewer want to visit or order this week.

  • The signature dish, made on camera. The tandoor, the sizzler, the stretch of the cheese.
  • The place at its best. A full Friday night, a birthday table, the rooftop at sunset. Show the experience people are paying for.
  • Clear, practical captions. Locality name, nearest metro station, price for two, timings and how to book or order.
  • Offers with a reason. A weekday lunch thali, a match-night combo, a winter special. A reason to visit now beats a generic "20% off".
  • Local creators, chosen carefully. A Delhi food creator with an audience in your part of the city is usually worth more than a bigger account with followers spread across India.

Then put a small budget behind the Reels that already perform. A boosted Reel targeted to a few kilometres around the restaurant, shown on Friday and Saturday, often does more for footfall than a city-wide campaign. sections.h2: Turn app customers into direct WhatsApp orders
sections.html:
WhatsApp is the most practical direct-ordering channel for a Delhi restaurant, because your customers already use it all day. A simple setup:

  1. Use WhatsApp Business with a catalogue of your menu, a greeting message and quick replies for the menu, delivery area and timings.
  2. Put the number everywhere: on the Google profile, Instagram bio, menu cards, table tents and the takeaway bag.
  3. Give a reason to switch. A free dessert or a small saving on the next order placed directly, printed on a card that goes into every delivery bag. Check your aggregator agreement for any rules on in-bag inserts and pricing parity before you do this.
  4. Take payment by UPI and confirm the delivery time in the same chat.
  5. Ask permission before you broadcast. Only message people who have chosen to hear from you, keep it to a weekly special or a festival menu, and make it easy to opt out.

If you move to the WhatsApp Business Platform for larger broadcasts, Meta charges for marketing messages and its rules change from time to time, so check the current pricing and template policies before you launch. Our guide to WhatsApp marketing for business in India covers click-to-WhatsApp ads, auto-replies and broadcast rules in detail.

Aggregators have long masked customer details. Zomato has said it is working with the National Restaurant Association of India on letting customers opt in to share their phone number with restaurants, and similar talks with Swiggy have been reported. Check what your partner dashboard offers today.

sections.h2: Small, local paid ads that bring orders
sections.html:
Restaurant ads in Delhi work best when they are narrow. Three set-ups that are worth testing:

Ad typeTargetingWhat to measure
Google Search ads"restaurant near me", cuisine + locality, "party hall" or "birthday party restaurant" within a few kmCalls, direction requests, table bookings
Meta click-to-WhatsApp ads2–5 km radius, evenings and weekendsWhatsApp orders and bookings received
Meta Reels adsLocality radius, people who engaged with your profileProfile visits, booking messages, walk-ins mentioning the ad

Run each test for two to three weeks and keep what brings countable orders. Group bookings, office lunches and birthday parties are often the most valuable searches, because one booking can be worth many single orders. If you want this handled for you, our Google Ads agency in Delhi NCR builds and tracks local search campaigns.

Demand in Delhi moves with the seasons and festivals. Plan a month ahead.

  • October to December: Navratri menus, Diwali gifting and party orders, office year-end parties, Christmas and New Year's Eve. Promote group bookings early; many offices decide in November.
  • Winter: Hot food, soups and tandoor dishes sell themselves on camera. Indoor seating and heaters are worth showing when air quality is poor and people prefer to eat in or order in.
  • Wedding season: Promote private sections and set menus for family gatherings.
  • Summer: Delivery and air-conditioned dine-in, cold drinks and lighter menus.

Each season gets one clear offer, one or two Reels, a Google post, an update to your WhatsApp status and catalogue, and a message to customers who have opted in.

1. Week 1: Pull three months of aggregator payout reports and calculate what you keep on an average order. Fix your Google profile: category, menu, photos, hours, ordering link.
  2. Week 2: Set up WhatsApp Business with a catalogue and quick replies. Print bag cards and table tents with your number and a review link.
  3. Week 3: Shoot six to eight Reels in one session and plan when to post them. Reply to every pending review.
  4. Week 4: Launch one small radius-targeted ad and one festival or weekday offer. Count direct orders, bookings and new reviews each week.

After a month you will know your real cost per aggregator order, how many customers moved to direct ordering and which posts brought people in. faqs: How can a restaurant in Delhi get more customers?

Complete your Google Business Profile with your menu, photos and exact hours, collect reviews every day, post Reels of your signature dishes with your locality in the caption, and run small radius-targeted ads around the restaurant on weekends.
Should I leave Zomato and Swiggy to save on commission?

Usually not. The apps are still the easiest way for new customers to find you. Use them for discovery and give those customers a reason, such as a direct-order offer card in the bag, to order from you on WhatsApp or by phone next time. Check your partner agreement for any rules first.
How much commission do Zomato and Swiggy charge restaurants?

Industry estimates for 2026 range from about 18% to 30% of order value, plus GST on platform fees and any ads or discounts you choose. Your actual rate depends on your contract, so check your partner agreement and payout reports.
Is Instagram or Google better for restaurant marketing?
You need both. Google Maps captures people who are already searching for a place to eat nearby, while Instagram creates demand by showing your food and space to people who were not looking yet.
How do I take food orders on WhatsApp?

Set up WhatsApp Business with a menu catalogue, greeting message and quick replies, share the number on your Google profile, Instagram and packaging, confirm each order and delivery time in the chat, and take payment by UPI.
